response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Every row in observatories counts as an observatory station, including any with zero telescopes (LEFT JOIN). The average share is therefore taken over all observatories, which equals 1 / number of observatories.
Total telescopes is the row count of telescopes, and share = telescope count / that total.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-observatory shares. The output is not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Only observatories that actually have at least one telescope are considered, so the average share is taken over stations appearing in telescopes. This is 1 / number of such stations.
